credit.credit-words: Open the Door for the Children
WORDS: Mary A. Kidder, pub.1870. MUSIC: “Open the Door”; Joel A. Erickson, 2003. Public Domain.

Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.... that my house may be filled. Lk. 14:21-23 Suffer little children to come unto me... for of such is the kingdom of God. 18:16
